svg.title: Exam papers: what each one needs first
svg.desc: Exam papers come in three parts. Before the exam: the admit card needs a published seat plan and the routine notice needs a schedule. In the exam hall: the seat list, invigilator sheet and seat stickers need a published seat plan; the blank marks sheet needs the marks parts set up. After results: the tabulation needs results processed; the mark sheets, result certificate and merit certificate need results published.
